# Loghub test fixtures

Small subsets of the official Loghub 2k samples
(https://github.com/logpai/loghub, commit dd61d0952749ee7963bde24220d1be5ede023033), regenerated
with `uv run python scripts/make_fixtures.py`. Rows are unmodified.

The datasets are freely available for research or academic work. Please cite: Jieming Zhu,
Shilin He, Pinjia He, Jinyang Liu, Michael R. Lyu. Loghub: A Large Collection of System Log
Datasets for AI-driven Log Analytics. ISSRE 2023. The full license notice is in `LICENSE`.
